cohort.selection_source: LP canonical bdb2025 snap-anchored cohort; eligible_input=true only

limitations: Tracking is sampled at 10 Hz, so event timing is quantized and sub-frame motion is not observed.
The terminal event marker is not a whistle timestamp.
Tracking does not attribute clock stoppage or runoff to rules, officials, timeout use, or other stoppage causes.

Ball-carrier identity is an unverified nearest-player-to-football inference at an event frame; candidate distances are retained, and only snap/pre-snap coordinates contribute to the reported kinematics.
Ball-carrier identity comes from a retrospective BDB label and is not an eligible prospective input; only the subject's snap and pre-snap tracking contributes to the reported kinematics.

method.carrier_subject: retrospective event frame; candidate is the nearest tracked player to football at the earliest acquisition marker (handoff/catch/interception/run), falling back to the earliest supported terminal marker; candidate ID is a retrospective label only, not cohort selection or model input; distance is retained because possession is not directly flagged
method.carrier_velocity_acceleration: finite differences of the candidate player's tracking x/y at snap and the two immediately preceding frames; future coordinates are used only to identify the retrospective subject, never for reported kinematics or model inputs
method.coordinate_units: yards; velocity in yards/second; acceleration in yards/second^2
method.duration: tracking terminal timestamp minus ball_snap timestamp; the source is sampled at 10 Hz
method.lp_clock_audit: optional retrospective cross-check and separate eight-class grouping only; it does not determine the primary tracking family or duration
method.outcome_family: normalized from the tracking terminal event only; null if no terminal event is resolved
method.percentiles: nearest lower empirical order statistic at floor(p*(n-1)); median uses the standard sample median
method.snap: manifest origin_frame, cross-checked against tracking frameType=SNAP and event=ball_snap
method.terminal: earliest tracking event in LP clock-audit TERMINAL taxonomy at or after the matched snap timestamp
